intro: **Esports broadcast graphics** only earn their place when they are right, and right now. AOBS builds **game API live data graphics**: scorebugs, drafts and stat panels that read the match directly and update the instant the game does.

data.title: Live scorebug
data.text: Teams, score, series and game clock, pulled from the match and always in sync with the action.

data.title: Draft & pick/ban
data.text: Hero picks and bans land on screen as they lock in. No operator retyping, no lag behind the client.

data.title: Player & team stats
data.text: KDA, gold, objectives and head-to-head panels built from the live feed, ready for the caster's next sentence.

data.title: Kill feed & events
data.text: First blood, objectives and team wipes trigger on-air moments automatically.

data.title: Economy & map data
data.text: Gold difference, objective timers and map state turned into graphics an audience can read at a glance.

motion.title: Show opens & intros
motion.text: The first ten seconds that tell viewers this is a real broadcast.

motion.title: Stingers & transitions
motion.text: Branded wipes in and out of replay, breaks and segments.

motion.title: 3D & VFX
motion.text: Trophies, team idents and environments built in 3D, composited for broadcast.

motion.title: AR elements
motion.text: Graphics placed into the camera shot rather than over it.

motion.title: Full graphics package
motion.text: Lower thirds, schedules, brackets, standings and winner screens in one consistent system.
